name: Weglot
tagline: Weglot is a website translation solution that automatically detects and translates web content into 110+ languages with a single line of code. Marketing teams and e-commerce businesses use it to launch multilingual versions of their website quickly, with machine-translated content that can be reviewed and corrected by professional translators directly in the Weglot interface. It handles SEO requirements like hreflang tags and translated URL slugs automatically, which purpose-built localization platforms often require manual configuration to achieve.
